info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Feldspar Recliner Detail-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows authorized users to submit detailed information about the Feldspar Recliner to the product catalog. It facilitates data entry for product specifications, features, and imagery, ensuring that all relevant details are accurately captured to enhance customer engagement. Typical consumers of this API are e-commerce platforms and inventory management systems that require up-to-date product information. By using this endpoint, organizations can effectively manage and showcase their recliner offerings.

post.summary: Create details for a Feldspar recliner.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for a Feldspar recliner. You can provide all necessary specifications and options for the recliner through the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to provide detailed information necessary for the operation of creating or updating a Feldspar Recliner's details. It encapsulates relevant data about the recliner, including specifications and options that might be applied during the operation.

200.description: Successful request, returning the requested recliner details.

CreateCatalogFeldsparReclinerDetailReque.title: Feldspar Recliner Order Request

feldspar_recliner_id.description: Unique identifier for the Feldspar recliner being ordered.

requestedBy.description: Name of the person requesting the order.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the order is a priority order.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit of the recliner.

CreateCatalogFeldsparReclinerDetailReque.description: Schema for submitting a request to order a Feldspar recliner. This includes details such as the recliner ID, requester information, quantity, priority, unit price, and dimensions.

ReclinerDimensions.title: Recliner Dimensions

width.description: Width of the recliner in specified units.

height.description: Height of the recliner in specified units.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for the dimensions (e.g., centimeters, inches).

ReclinerDimensions.description: Schema representing the dimensions of the Feldspar recliner.

CreateCatalogFeldsparReclinerDetailRespo.title: Response for Feldspar Recliner Details Operations

recordId.description: The identifier of the record that was processed.

processedAt.description: The timestamp when the processing was completed.

matchedCount.description: The count of matched records found during the operation.

CreateCatalogFeldsparReclinerDetailRespo.description: This schema represents the response structure for the operations related to Feldspar Recliner details after a POST request. It contains the status of the operation, the record identifier, the processing timestamp, the count of matched records, and pricing details.

Pricing.title: Pricing Details

net.description: The net amount before any additional charges or taxes.

currency.description: The currency in which the pricing is specified.

taxIncluded.description: Indicates whether the tax is included in the net amount.

Pricing.description: This schema contains the pricing details for the operation, including the net amount, currency, and tax inclusion status.
